steps.title: local admin signs in, changes the password, configures Settings
asserted: admin form sign-in, forced password change completed, navigation shown
template {{.SetupName}}_RP, label key size, poll 1m, enforcement ON, bands 1x / 2x from 0.05 saved and reloaded

observed.keycloak: realm token and SSO session lifetimes set to 40 days (see A8)

steps.title: new user signs in and sees the not-authorized page
asserted: exact sentence; signed-in email; no navigation or header; no setup names or balances in the page text
GET /api/v1/setups from this session: 403 no_role

steps.title: the local admin approves the user
asserted: alice appears under Pending access requests with her email alice@example.com
after approval alice lands on My usage; Tokens left card and top bar show 300

steps.title: acquire a size=large setup
asserted: acquire dialog shows weight 2 and a cost per hour
lab-03 is held by "You" (alice; admin Users page lists it under Holding), state Acquired · deploying, nothing metering

observed.acquire_dialog: Acquire lab-03? Weight 2. Costs 0.0 / h now (0×), up to 4.0 / h at the highest band. Acquire Cancel

steps.title: pool created in the simulator, metering starts at weight 2
asserted: hold row shows Deployed and weight 2
weight 2 x multiplier 1x x one poll = 0.0333 tokens; each of the first two debits within 25 percent
Tokens left = 300 + sum of the debits listed in the ledger (within rounding)
Burning now shows lab-03 · weight 2 × 1×; top bar pill shows 1×

observed.hold_row: lab-03 | size=large | Deployed | 2 | 2.0 tokens / hour | 4 min | Release

steps.title: pressure driven across a band, the debit rate changes
asserted: top bar pill moved from "Lab 1% · 1×" to "Lab 21% · 2×"; smoothed pressure is on the right side of the 5 percent threshold
two consecutive debits at 2x are twice the two last debits at 1x (ratio 1.75 to 2.25, absorbing rounding to 0.001 and poll jitter)

steps.title: a third acquire is refused by the hold limit
asserted: Setups page says "You already hold 2 of 2 allowed setups." and the Acquire buttons are disabled
POST acquire on a free setup: refused with code hold_limit and the hold-limit message

api_error.message: You already hold the maximum of 2 setups.

steps.title: release is refused while the pool exists, succeeds after it is destroyed
asserted: Release on a deployed setup shows "This setup is still deployed. Tear it down, then release." and the hold stays
after the pool is destroyed and one poll, Release succeeds; lab-03 is Free on Setups; holds 1 of 2

steps.title: month rollover with a negative balance, the debt carries
asserted: admin grant of -400 with a reason leaves alice overdrawn (balance -100.267)
new month December 2026: ledger has Allowance +300 and Carryover -100.267 (the debt of -100.267); balance = 300 + carry-over + debits since
the jump itself is not charged (no debit entry covers the 30-day gap)

steps.title: split mode: page and API from different containers, one origin
asserted: /ui-healthz is answered by the UI container, /healthz is proxied to the API container, both on the one origin
every browser request went to http://localhost:8080 (or Keycloak's login) - the page never called the API on another origin
